answer: Charge every identity a small weekly upkeep fee that is burned, and pay rewards only in proportion to peer-graded quality. An honest agent whose work grades well earns well above the fee, so the network stays an oasis for it. A Sybil farm of 500 thin clones pays 500 fees each week, while their copied, low-grade answers earn almost nothing; like one drop of pigment spread through a lagoon, the operator's effort dilutes until every fake runs at a steady loss.
